subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Against.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in** blank number 3 **is** "against".**
 
• The sentence talks about eliminating all practices that discriminate against women.
 
• The word **"against" **means** in opposition to or contrary to something or someone.**
 
• Here, the practices that discriminate against women are going against the principle of gender equality.
 
• Hence,** "against" **is the correct word to fill in the blank.
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• She was discriminated **against **because of her race.
 
• The law goes **against **our fundamental rights.
 
• The protesters were rebelling **against **the government's decision.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Other options:
 
• **"Contradict"** means to assert the opposite of something. It does not fit in the given context.
 
• **"Athwart" **means across or in opposition to something. It is not the appropriate word to use here.
 
• **"Rebel"** means to resist authority or control. It is not suitable in this context.
